story: World′s tallest elevator tower rises in Rottweil, Germany (2015)
text: The "new paternoster" is quite a different beast. Tom Scott did a video on it: [VIDEO] I live close to the tower and was really positively surprised how it turned out. Often, an architect's "vision" is far from what it ends up looking, but since this tower got its cladding, it looks spectacular - especially when the sun is low in the early morning or evening hours.

There is also a Tom Scott video about the test tower for the Thyssen Multi, with some more details [VIDEO] It will be interesting to see how it will be used. You really need someone bold enough to design a building around high capacity, 2d elevators. And if the elevators don't work out you have severe problems using the building ... Selling this has to be an uphill battle until it's proven in a few locations.
